title: Grade 11 Mathematics — Sequences and Series & Straight Lines
description: Sequences and Series and Straight Lines practice questions
subject: mathematics

questions.question: In a geometric progression (GP), each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by:
options: A fixed number called common difference
A fixed number called common ratio
questions.explanation: In a GP, each term = previous term × common ratio (r). Example: 2, 6, 18, 54, ... has r = 3.

The sum of an infinite GP with |r| < 1 is:
questions.explanation: Sum of infinite GP = a/(1 − r), valid only when |r| < 1 (converging series). As n → ∞, the rⁿ term → 0.

questions.question: The sum 1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 100 =
questions.explanation: Sum = n(n+1)/2 = 100 × 101/2 = 5050. This is the famous result attributed to Gauss.

questions.question: The geometric mean (GM) of two numbers a and b is:
questions.explanation: The geometric mean of a and b is √(ab). If three numbers a, G, b are in GP, then G² = ab, so G = √(ab).

questions.question: If a, b, c are in AP, then b equals:
questions.explanation: If a, b, c are in AP: b − a = c − b → 2b = a + c → b = (a+c)/2. b is the arithmetic mean of a and c.

The slope of a line making angle 45° with the positive x-axis is:
questions.explanation: Slope m = tan θ, where θ is the angle with positive x-axis. tan 45° = 1.

questions.question: The equation of a line with slope m and y-intercept c is:
questions.explanation: Slope-intercept form: y = mx + c, where m is slope and c is the y-intercept (value of y when x = 0).

questions.question: The slope of a line passing through (2, 3) and (5, 9) is:
Two lines are parallel if their slopes are:
questions.explanation: Two lines are parallel if they have the same slope (m₁ = m₂) but different y-intercepts. Perpendicular lines have slopes satisfying m₁ × m₂ = −1.

questions.question: The distance from point (3, −2) to the line 3x − 4y + 5 = 0 is:
The x-intercept of the line 2x + 3y = 12 is:
questions.explanation: x-intercept: set y = 0. 2x = 12 → x = 6. The line crosses the x-axis at (6, 0).

questions.question: The equation of a vertical line passing through (4, 0) is:
questions.explanation: A vertical line has undefined slope and equation x = constant. The vertical line through (4, 0) is x = 4.
